brief:
Walid Farrajah, a physician in Bethlehem, has transformed a childhood gift into a decades-long passion for poultry breeding, Palestine News Network reported. His uncle gave him a small group of chicks when he was 10 years old, sparking an interest that has persisted throughout his education and professional career.

Farrajah has developed his breeding work into a serious craft focused on show birds, maintaining the hobby alongside his responsibilities as a doctor in the West Bank.
dek: BETHLEHEM, West Bank /PNN/ When Walid Farrajah was 10, his uncle gave him a small group of chicks. What began as a simple childhood gift grew into a lifelong passion that has stayed with him alongside his career as a doctor.
title: Palestinian doctor breeds show birds alongside medical practice
